Chresten Gamborg Puggaard is a data manager at RKKP (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudvikling) and holds a cand. polit. degree [^src1]. He serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], the steering group responsible for overseeing the Danish Atrial Fibrillation database (AFDK) [^src1]. In this capacity, his professional background ensures the group maintains vital competence in data structure, technical infrastructure, and the administrative handling of clinical quality data [^src1]. 

His involvement is documented in the 2024 AFDK report, which outlines the quality development framework for treating atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1]. The report emphasizes the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral composition of the steering group, which is tasked with managing the database's legal anchoring, data foundations, and clinical practices such as structured patient education [^src1]. Through his technical and administrative role, Puggaard supports the broader initiative to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for chronic heart disease patients, while also helping the group navigate and document methodological limitations in national data collection [^src1].
